## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based 3D first-person fantasy RPG inspired by Neverwinter Nights and Skyrim, using Dungeons & Dragons 3.5-style mechanics.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build the game now and briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original adventure, **Ashen Vale**, with a hand-built Three.js world and a simplified D&D-style combat loop.
- Used custom geometry instead of external art assets to keep the game self-contained.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added Vite project setup and a polished responsive game interface with intro screen, HUD, controls, combat log, and game-over screen.
- Implemented a 3D first-person valley, movement/look controls, sword attacks, magic missiles, healing potions, enemy AI, XP/level-ups, and an altar victory objective.
- Batched static world geometry to reduce draw calls.
- `npm run build` succeeded; browser smoke tests completed without JavaScript page errors. Tested gameplay showed enemy defeat and changing health/objective state.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally rerun `npm run build` after the latest geometry batching changes.
2. Summarize the finished game and controls to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `index.html`: Game page, HUD, intro, and game-over interface.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and HUD styling.
- `src/main.js`: First-person controls, combat, AI, progression, and game loop.
- `src/world.js`: Procedural 3D world, scenery, and enemies.
- `package-lock.json`: Installed dependency lockfile.

## Important Context
- Local dev server was started with `npm run dev -- --port 3000`.
- Temporary browser checks and screenshots were saved under `/tmp/opencode/`; the latest gameplay check reported one sentinel defeated and player health at `28 / 36`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

- **WASD** to move, **mouse** to look
- **Click** or **Space** to attack
- **F** to cast a magic missile, **Q** to use a healing potion
- Defeat the three guardians, then **E** at the altar to finish the adventure
